lead: Use when a module or a call between modules is added in a repo that keeps a system map, when a checker reports the map stale, and for any diagram, flow, or architecture frame drawn on Miro from code.

diagrams-sync.cue: a code change moved the system map or its board

miro-board.cue: draw or update a frame, fix overlaps, pull layout back

diagrams-init.cue: give a repo a system map generated from its code

browser-setup.cue: the live check has no browser tools or cannot reach Miro
